reg_mapping.mapped_to_condition: when EL3 is not implemented and EL2 is implemented

purpose_text.para: Controls the generation of MPAM information for memory requests when executing at EL1 and EL0.

field_description.para: MPAM Enable. MPAM is enabled when MPAMEN == 1. When disabled, all PARTIDs and PMGs are output as their default value in the corresponding ID space.

field_value_description.para: The default PARTID and default PMG are output in MPAM information from all Exception levels.
MPAM information is output based on the MPAMn_ELx register for ELn according to the MPAM configuration.

field_description.para: Enables use of the alternative PMG configured in MPAM1_EL1.altPMG for instruction fetch accesses originating at EL1.

field_value_description.para: The alternative PMG configured in MPAM1_EL1.altPMG is not used for generating MPAM information for instruction fetch accesses.
The alternative PMG configured in MPAM1_EL1.altPMG is used for generating MPAM information for instruction fetch accesses.

field_description.para: Enables use of the alternative PARTID configured in MPAM1_EL1.altPARTID for instruction fetch accesses originating at EL1.

field_value_description.para: The alternative PARTID configured in MPAM1_EL1.altPARTID is not used for generating MPAM information for instruction fetch accesses.
The alternative PARTID configured in MPAM1_EL1.altPARTID is used for generating MPAM information for instruction fetch accesses.

field_description.para: Enables use of the alternative PMG configured in MPAM0_EL1.altPMG for instruction fetch accesses originating at EL0.
When the Effective value of HCR_EL2.{E2H, TGE} is {1, 1}, this bit has no effect on execution at EL0.

field_value_description.para: The alternative PMG configured in MPAM0_EL1.altPMG is not used for generating MPAM information for instruction fetch accesses.
The alternative PMG configured in MPAM0_EL1.altPMG is used for generating MPAM information for instruction fetch accesses.

field_description.para: Enables use of the alternative PARTID configured in MPAM0_EL1.altPARTID for instruction fetch accesses originating at EL0.
When the Effective value of HCR_EL2.{E2H, TGE} is {1, 1}, this bit has no effect on execution at EL0.

field_value_description.para: The alternative PARTID configured in MPAM0_EL1.altPARTID is not used for generating MPAM information for instruction fetch accesses.
The alternative PARTID configured in MPAM0_EL1.altPARTID is used for generating MPAM information for instruction fetch accesses.

access_permission_text.para: When the Effective value of HCR_EL2.E2H is 1, without explicit synchronization, accesses from EL3 using the accessor name MPAMCTL_EL1 or MPAMCTL_EL12 are not guaranteed to be ordered with respect to accesses using the other accessor name.
